seo_title: AI Upselling Agent: Skyrocket Your MRR on Autopilot
seo_desc: We integrate an AI Agent that analyzes your customers' usage and automates upselling with Stripe links. Boost your MRR without hiring more sales reps.
author_pitch: I have seen too many SaaS companies stuck because their sales reps waste time chasing free-tier users. My obsession is connecting data with AI so your software sells itself, scaling your revenue without inflating your payroll.
title: B2B AI Upselling Agent: Scale Your SaaS MRR Automatically
body:
Are you dealing with hundreds of users on basic plans while your team lacks the capacity to sell them premium upgrades?

The biggest bottleneck for SaaS founders and B2B agencies is not client acquisition, but account expansion. Your users hit their limits, experience friction, and without receiving a personalized offer at the exact right moment, they get frustrated or move to a competitor. You are losing thousands in MRR simply because no one sent them a checkout link on time.

The trap of bulk upgrade emails

Sending a generic newsletter to your entire database begging them to upgrade their plan is useless. It completely ignores the user's context and actual behavior on the platform. Effective upselling requires surgical precision, not brute-force spam.

Our solution: Predictive AI Upselling Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we engineered an AI Agent that monitors your users' usage patterns (API consumption, storage, login frequency). When it detects a client is ready to scale, it initiates a hyper-personalized conversation and dynamically generates production-ready Stripe payment links, closing the sale without human intervention and notifying your team via Telegram.

  1. Real-time behavior analysis: The AI cross-references usage data from your database to identify imminent buying signals.
  2. Contextual and dynamic offers: Generation of emails or in-app messages highlighting the exact benefits the user needs to unlock.
  3. Autonomous closing with Stripe: Creation of unique, secure checkout sessions for an immediate transition to the Premium plan.
  4. Expansion alerts via Telegram: Instant notifications to your phone every time the AI Agent successfully secures an upgrade.

The Real Impact on Your Growth Metrics

  • Direct MRR increase: Convert free or basic users into high-value accounts entirely on autopilot.
  • Zero sales hiring costs: Scale your internal sales without adding a single salary to your B2B sales department.
  • Frictionless user experience: Deliver the exact solution right at the millisecond the client hits their plan limit.
